scope: Settings navigation experiment only; not certificate installation or YouTube playback

safari.invocation: Actual taps on anchors in a local HTTP diagnostic page
safari.result: Each displayed Safari's invalid-address alert; none opened the target

shortcuts.creation: Created in the simulator's Shortcuts UI, not injected into its database
shortcuts.name: LocalFilter Profiles
shortcuts.action: Open URLs with a fixed literal URL, followed by Nothing to suppress output
shortcuts.directRunResult: Opened Settings > General > Device Management; heading observed as Gestion de l'appareil and empty profile list
shortcuts.nativeBridgePrecondition: Settings was manually returned to its root screen before launching the app test
shortcuts.nativeBridgeInvocation: A real tap on Open profiles with shortcut in LocalFilter's isolated Debug view
shortcuts.initialNativeBridgeResult: Reached Device Management, then a delayed Shortcuts privacy prompt asked permission to output the URL text
shortcuts.correction: Append Nothing after Open URLs; do not return the URL to the calling app
shortcuts.correctedNativeBridgeResult: One tap in LocalFilter reached Device Management. A later UI observation and screenshot still showed the destination without the output-permission prompt; no permission approval was clicked.
shortcuts.diagnosticPreparationButton: Opened a new Shortcuts editor; the simulator pasteboard contained exactly the fixed profile-list URL

distribution.generatedArtifact: Unsigned source containing URL, Open URLs and Nothing actions; no dynamic input, network request actions or output
distribution.signingResult: Error: In order to do this, you must be signed into iCloud.
distribution.limit: The UI-created simulator shortcut works. A distributable signed file and its Add Shortcut flow have not been validated. The manual diagnostic setup does not meet the consumer onboarding requirement.

limits: No physical iOS 18 bridge test yet
The simulator does not reproduce the physical device's full VPN/profile-management UI
No pending profile or certificate trust screen was tested in this experiment
No App Store acceptance or cross-version reliability claim
A shortcut must exist under the expected name; UIKit's accepted callback alone cannot establish success
